I'll compute the sum of the decimal digits of 48^11 to verify the provided result.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 48^11
result = 48**11
print(f"48^11 = {result}")

# Get the digits and sum them
digits = [int(d) for d in str(result)]
digit_sum = sum(digits)

print(f"Digits: {digits}")
print(f"Sum of digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
